scenario: virtual client joins real DS host and sends dot with padded final rebroadcast
notes: Canonical outbound-message capture. The virtual station authenticates, associates into slot 1, completes profile initialization, sends a 2,084-byte 256x16 dot drawing, and the real DS host rebroadcasts all fourteen fragments. The final logical four-byte fragment is physically padded to a 160-byte host transfer slot; this capture identified the decoder bug that previously produced a false delivery timeout.
